preview: Asmita Raina shares her Hilti interview experience for an internship, covering the online assessment and technical and HR interview rounds.
content: HILTI INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE ASMITA RAINA Location : Pune September 06, 2023 : PRE-PLACEMENT TALK Students of CS, IT, Extc, Electronics, Electrical and Civil having a 7.5 or above cpi were eligible to apply for this company. The company presentation was held online on 6th September from 5-6pm. It is strongly recommended to attend these presentations as getting insights about the company and its work culture is important specially in the HR interview round. September 07, 2023 : ONLINE ASSESSMENT The online assessment started with 2 coding questions : 1) Mr. Myers and the Exam - A mathematics question paper has certain number of questions and each question is assigned some random maximum marks. Mr. Myers wants to edit the marks assigned to the questions such that: 1. All questions in the paper should have distinct maximum marks. 2. The total marks of all the questions should be as low as possible. Mr. Myers wants to achieve this by making minimal changes in the original format, assigning the question at least as much marks as it originally had. Find the minimum total marks that he can set the paper for. Input Specification: Input1: The number of questions in the paper Input2: The array representing the original marks assigned to every question. Output Specification: The minimum total marks Mr. Myers can set the paper for. 2) Given a list of numbers indicating the window number and a number indicating the window number to be accessed, modify and return the list after applying the MRU strategy. In order to implement the Windows screen switch shortcut (WIN + TAB), we need to use a Most Recently Used (MRU) strategy which brings the recently accessed window to the front. Example: input list - [5, 2, 3, 4, 1], window number to be accessed - 2 output list - [2, 5, 3, 4, 1] Here, as Google Chrome is being accessed at the moment, the next time we use WIN + TAB, it will appear at the front of the list. There were 10 test cases – 7 sample test cases, 2 necessary cases and 1 Edge case as listed on Mettl. I couldn’t solve 1 Necessary case and 1 Edge case. There were ample choices for the preferred programming language for the question, I chose c++. After the online assessment round, 21 students got selected for the further interview rounds. September 08, 2023 : ONLINE INTERVIEW ROUND 1 Once I got selected for the interview round, first of all yes I was very happy and scared at the same time being very apprehensive about how I’ll answer my questions, what if I fumble etc. Keeping that feeling aside, I started brushing up interview questions for the following topics - 1. DSA 2. OS 3. DBMS 4. OOPs Concept The above topics are the ones which need to be fully prepared. Additionally since I had mentioned a few more topics in my resume and had used a few more concepts in my projects, to be on the safer side I also revised - 1. ReactJS 2. Python 3. Java Basics 4. MongoDB Next day, the interview rounds started with the technical interview. I had my interview around 10AM and I was a bit nervous as well but would suggest everyone to just stay calm before the interview, revise few interview questions from websites like InterviewBit, where I had practiced from. Firstly, I was asked to introduce myself followed by questions regarding my skills and projects in resume. The “Tell me about yourself “ question should be well prepared. That way you will get a good headstart and it will boost your confidence. For the DSA part - 1) I was asked about Binary search algorithm. 2) Find the missing number in the array (This question can be referred through this link - https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/find-the-missing-number/ ) For the coding part he told me to write the pseudocode in notepad so that he can understand my thought process and logic to solve the question. NOTE - Remember to think loudly and explain whatever logic is coming in your mind. He then asked me about the 4 pillars of OOPs followed by basic differences in the functionality of c++, python and java. Lastly, for DBMS he asked me the difference between SQL and PostgreSQL after which he asked me whether I had any questions for him. NOTE - Always ask 1-2 questions at the end to show that you are inquisitive and interested for the interview. I asked about how the training program goes about for the interns and then I also asked about the areas in which the interviewer felt that I needed improvement. September 08, 2023 : ONLINE INTERVIEW HR Round Just as my first round got completed, immediately I got informed to be ready for my Round 2 which was the HR Round. The HR for my panel was from Malaysia and she fortunately was very very sweet. First few minutes of the interview or rather I should say discussion went in our introductions, family background, reason I chose IT in VJTI, reason I chose to come to Mumbai etc. Since the HR was herself from Tech background she asked me about my projects and how was the work done, my contributions in them, what were the challenges faced, how were they resolved etc. The HR round completed quickly, it was a very positive and satisfying interview because the HR made me feel very comfortable and I was able to answer all her questions honestly and confidently. PS: Key point to remember in HR Round is that whatever you are saying, it should be honest and you should deliver your answers very confidently and also don’t shy away in asking the HR to repeat the question if you didn’t understand at the first go to avoid giving inaccurate answers. This way my HR Round got over. Here as well at the end she asked me whether I had some questions for her to which I asked about all the extracurricular amenities, work culture etc. at HTSI and at the end asked for my feedback. September 08, 2023 : RESULTS In the end, everything wrapped up smoothly and as scheduled. The results came around 6 or 6:30PM for which I was anxiously waiting. Finally when they came, I saw my name at the top of the list of final selects and I was truly very happy to see that. There was a sense of relief that “chalo internship lag gyi finally”... TIPS - 1. Don’t panic and be calm in any situation even if you aren’t able to remember an answer clearly. 2. Focus on your resume. Mention your strong projects first in the list and be well prepared to answer any question regarding your projects. 3. Confidence is the key, specially in the HR Round. Try to show your worth as in why you are important for the company. Asmita Raina Hilti Intern
